tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: What Callstay is, which tools exist, what prices mean, and the human desk's phone number. Call first.

tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Find hotels for a place, dates and party. Returns up to 48 properties with an indicative nightly and total, rating and a URL that carries the dates.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Full detail for one property by slug: description, facilities, check-in and check-out times, parking, pets, children, policies, review summary and nearby places.

tools.name: price_stay
tools.description: Every room and rate one property has for an exact stay, live from the supplier. Each room has an all-in total, itemised fees, cancellation terms and a booking URL. `status` says whether an empty list is no rooms or a supplier outage.
